messages:
maria: Heads-up — ap-northeast pool7 is seeing a sustained rise in correctable ECCs over the last 40m (from ~12/hr to ~280/hr). Not an immediate wreckage but it's trending and we've seen jobs requeueing on two nodes. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/GPUs/pool7-correctables?orgId=1

ajay: Which nodes/cards? any xid/unrecoverable events?

maria: Mostly rack-aps7 nodes: aps7-card12/13/15 are hot. sample from metrics:
```
node=aps7-node-12 card=card12 correctables_last_1h=312 correctables_last_5m=78
node=aps7-node-13 card=card13 correctables_last_1h=287 correctables_last_5m=64
```
No new XIDs or UBs seen yet.

ops-bot: [ALERT] High correctable ECC rate on ap-northeast/pool7 at 2024-10-14T01:04:12Z — severity=warning

tyler: My worry is cascade if we start full soft-drains. Proposal: staggered soft-evict per-card with a dampening heartbeat window + schedule-throttle for the rack. Start with a 10% capacity throttling and 5-minute stagger between card soft-evicts. Example command to soft-evict one node:
```
redwoodctl node drain --node aps7-node-12 --mode soft --grace 300 --card card12
```
This avoids immediate requeue storms.

jun: +1 to staggered. Also propose bumping autodrain threshold for correctables from 200->400 for the next 6h in ap-northeast to avoid noisy-card churn. Config snippet:
```
autodrain:
  filter: region=="ap-northeast" and pool=="pool7"
  correctable_threshold: 400
  window: 3600
```
Caveat: increases risk of a slow-degrading card being left alive longer. Monitor carefully.

ajay: Can we run an evacuation simulation with the current pool topology? `evac-sim --pool pool7 --burst 350` — want to see latency and capacity impact before changing thresholds.

tyler: I'll run evac-sim now and post results in 10m. If sim shows <5% tail latency regress and <10% capacity loss, we can canary the config for 6h.

maria: Action items: tyler — run sim and post results; jun — prepare config diff as PR; ajay — coordinate canary window & notify @oncall-sre. Plan dry-run at 03:00 UTC with ops present. I'll hold off on manual drains until sim completes. :handshake:

ops-bot: Reminder set — dry-run scheduled at 03:00 UTC (channel: #eng-infra) — id=reminder-8812
